evidence: Adds C and C++ API functions and types to libbitcoinkernel in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{h,cpp} and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h, along with kernel tests in src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp.
rationale: Adds an optional script evaluation tracer to the libbitcoinkernel C/C++ API to inspect intermediate execution states. External developers can build script debuggers and execution analyzers, and the author demonstrated this with a proof-of-concept debugger targeting rust-bitcoinkernel. While a clear addition to library functionality, it is an auxiliary developer feature rather than core block/chainstate verification and is reasonably deferrable.
